ablations.title: Instruction contracts and reasoning

ablations.title: Global propagation for target selection
ablations.description: Forced-Early selects targets from semantic and spatial matches before the solver checks route constraints. ReCoNav uses complete-route feasibility and preference costs to guide target selection.
